11.   ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
      Cheyenne changing the zoning classification of AG Agricultural, LR Low-Density
      Residential, MR Medium-Density Residential, HI Heavy Industrial, and CB Community
      Business to AG Agricultural and LI Light Industrial for land located southwest of the I-
      25 and I-80 Interchange adjacent to Roundtop Rd.

ACTION:

16.   RESOLUTION – Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for
      Cheyenne Terrace, 2nd Filing, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located east
      of Converse Avenue and south of Storey Boulevard). (SPONSOR – MR. ROYBAL)

      (April 1, 2024 - CLERK’S NOTE: the location of this Final Plat is in fact “south of West
      5th Street between Patton Avenue and Snyder Avenue. A substitute correcting the
      entitlement language will be presented prior to final approval.)

ACTION:

17.   RESOLUTION – Requiring the study and submittal of a report to the Governing Body
      analyzing the best avenue for correcting deficiencies and improving and maintaining the
      west entryway to the Municipal Building to enhance public perception and experience.
      (SPONSORS – MR. ESQUIBEL, MR. LAYBOURN, MR. ROYBAL AND MR.
      SEGRAVE)
